Marta V: Heads-up: Acme pre-call at 10am PST. They want ephemeral creds, KMS envelope proof, and a sample SIEM export. Need a quick runbook and artifacts.

Chris L: I can do KMS envelope sample. Do we have HSM-backed envelope examples we can share? Quick, minimal.

Samir K: Put this snippet as a minimal example:
```json
{"envelope":"VGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3Q=","key_id":"kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/rdw-key-1"}
```

Lina Q: For SIEM sample, include fields: tenant.id, request_id, actor.service, key_wrap_event, action=Decrypt|Encrypt, retained=false

Marta V: Customer expects retention 13 months and redaction on prompt payloads. Can we show an example of redacted log with hashes?

Chris L: Yes — we publish redacted entries with prompt_hash and zeroed content. Example: `prompt_hash=sha256:3b7f2e...`, and store raw in sealed evidence bundle only; sample command:
`echo -n "user prompt" | sha256sum`

sec-bot: evidence-pack created: s3://evidence-precall/acme/6131112223/ (private link)

Samir K: Also note for pre-call: show our KMS wrapping proof: include wrap event id, envelope metadata, and operator IAM change audit. I'll prepare a one-pager.

Lina Q: I'll generate a SIEM export CSV with redacted fields and attach. ETA 30m.

Marta V: Awesome. If anyone has objections to including HSM cert chain in the pack, flag now. Otherwise I'll assemble and send to AE.

Chris L: No objections. :thumbsup:

Marta V: Thanks team — will post pack link here when ready.
